summary: Deere & Co. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Deere Funding Canada Corporation, issued $300M of 4.850% Notes due 2031, fully guaranteed by Deere. The notes were registered on Form S-3 and underwritten by Barclays, Credit Agricole, Deutsche Bank, RBC, and TD Securities. The filing describes interest payment terms, redemption provisions, and ranking. This is an ordinary debt offering, not a special situation. No special-situation catalyst is present.
